description:
2x Urbikany Bush Tomato - Mini Plug Plants | Early Siberian Salad Variety

 Get a head start on your garden with this high-yielding, cold-hardy Siberian classic! These Urbikany Bush tomatoes are legendary for their vigor and ability to produce juicy, sweet fruit much earlier than standard varieties.


 Item Specifics

   Variety: Urbikany (Siberian Heritage)
  


   Plant Form: 2x Mini Plug Plants
  


   Type: Salad / Bush (Determinate)
  


   Growth Habit: Sprawling Bush (Approx. 3ft tall)
  


   Fruit Size: 2-inch, perfectly round red fruit
  


   Harvest: Very early and continuous throughout summer
  


 Why Choose Urbikany?

 These plants are a standout success from early-season trials. They are specifically bred for shorter growing seasons but perform brilliantly in any garden.


   Vigorous Start: Grown from large, high-quality seeds for a strong root system and fast initial growth.
  


   Early & Prolific: You'll be picking salad tomatoes weeks before your neighbors! Expect heavy crops of 2-inch, perfectly round red fruits.
  


   Superior Flavor: A classic tomato taste—juicy with an excellent balance of sweetness and acidity.
  


   Compact but Mighty: While they only reach about 3ft in height, their heavy yield means they are sprawlers.
  


  Gardener’s Tip: Because these plants produce such a massive amount of fruit, they will need several stakes or strings to support the weight!
 

 Postage & Packaging

 Your mini plugs will be carefully packaged to ensure they arrive in peak condition, ready to be potted on or planted out after the last frost.


 Buy now to ensure an early harvest of delicious, home-grown salad tomatoes!
